scheme_name: Prime Minister Early Career Research Grant
other_conditions: Applicant must be an Indian citizen; OCI/PIO candidates are eligible as Principal Investigator only when collaborating with an Indian Co‑PI.
Applicant must hold a Ph.D. in Science or Engineering or an MD/MS/MDS/MVSc degree.
Applicant must be in a regular academic/research position at a recognized academic institution, national laboratory, or other recognized R&D institution.
Applicant must apply within two years of joining the institution.
Applicant must not have received funding under YSS, ECR, SRG, CRG (erstwhile EMR), EMEQ, or any other project grant from SERB or ANRF.
Only one proposal can be submitted per call and only a one‑time career grant is provided; the project cannot be extended or transferred except in specified institutional transfers.
If the Principal Investigator wishes to terminate the project, immediate notice must be given to ANRF and the institute must cease all related expenditures.
benefits_summary: Research grant of up to ₹60 lakh plus overheads for three years, covering personnel, consumables, travel, equipment, contingency, and providing flexibility for international travel, open‑access publications and patent filing.
